title: Scheduled Maintenance: Database Performance & Capacity
summary: We're performing planned database maintenance to expand capacity and improve performance. While we've reserved a two-hour window, we expect actual disruption to last only a few minutes, during which Langdock may be briefly unavailable or slower than usual. No data will be affected. We've scheduled this during off-peak hours to minimize disruption. Thank you for your patience! The Langdock Team
